integrity: The finite certificate contains two independent modular evaluation methods for every tested index, a complete 345-prime census, six first-order nondegeneracy checks, and direct second-level lifts; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The least-prime assertion is certified by a complete finite search through 2339; it does not address primes above that bound or multiplicity at least seven. The all-depth assertion applies only to the six roots at 2339 and relies on the published nondegenerate lifting theorem.
title: The first six Schenker residues and their six Hensel branches
